name: Wada Kohei
source:
[spoiler]Ariko's uncle on her mother's side.

While still figuring out how to interact with his niece he suddenly re-united with, he is overjoyed as Ariko warms up to him more and more. But he has to keep up his cool image, so he won't show it. It bothers him slightly that he tends to be seen as older than he is.[/spoiler]
